    <p style="font-size:7.4pt;color:#454f59;margin:2mm 0 0">
      <b>Column 3:</b> name juniors, a named team, or everyone &mdash; named, not categorised.
      <b>Column 4:</b> the signal and where it would surface; "we would not" is a legitimate entry.
      <b>Column 5:</b> "we would not" triggers a detection action with an owner and a date in column 9.
      <b>Column 6:</b> our concrete instantiation: what the exercise is, on what code, run by whom.
      <b>Column 7:</b> a recurring commitment with a period; "periodically" and "when we can" fail this column.
      <b>Column 8:</b> the sprint capacity, budget line or rota slot this consumes.
      <b>Column 10:</b> qualitative: what we would observe if the practice were working. Not a score, and never attached to an individual.
      <b>Column 11:</b> booked, not intended.
      <b>Column 12:</b> the corresponding row of WS-05-agent-risk-register.
    </p>
